votes.motion: recommend APPROVAL of the proposed Timberline Development Agreement for property located at 13518 and 13506 South Redwood Road as presented, subject to the following amendments/conditions: Conditions: 1. Zoning for the project shall be RM-6 with lot sizes, setbacks, and road widths compliant with that zone. 2. The Site Plan shall be subject to Final Site Plan review and approval in accordance with Riverton City Code. 3. No vehicular access to 13550 South and 1775 West shall be made, with 1775 West terminating in a turnaround as shown and as approved during final Site Plan. 4. Perimeter fencing

APPROVE Application #PLZ 26-8002 “My Storage Riverton” Final Site Plan and Conditional Use Permit, subject to the following: Conditions: 1. Site Plan and Building Architecture may be amended as shown. 2. Rooftop mechanical must be screened. 3. All other Site Plan Improvements shall be consistent with the plans and amendments previously approved by the Planning Commission. Commissioner Beck

APPROVE Application PLZ-26-8023, “Walmart Fuel Center Amended Site Plan”, subject to the following: Conditions: 1. Site Plan Improvements shall be consistent with the plans presented to the Planning Commission except where otherwise noted. Commissioner Marzo

APPROVE Application PLZ-25-804, “Walmart Supercenter Amended Site Plan”, subject to the following: Conditions: 1. Site Plan Improvements shall be consistent with the plans presented to the Planning Commission except where otherwise noted. 2. Applicant shall correct or resolve any staff redlines on the civil site plans. Commissioner Marzo

recommend APPROVAL of the amended 2nd Amendment to the Mountain View Place Development Agreement, subject to the following: Conditions: 1. The Development Agreement be amended to allow a total of 302 residential units. Commissioner Matheson
